evidence: All 40 units cover exactly the 40 source entities; each event_code, follow_up_trigger and severity matches its Dxx-OFFICIAL document (low/medium/high distribution verified entity-by-entity).
Every unit cites Dxx-OFFICIAL and Dxx-LATE as sources, the two authoritative confirmations; the late official-update independently corroborates severity in all 40 cases.

Tail documents are handled by exclusion: uncorroborated anonymous rumors (Dxx-RUMOR), outdated archive denials superseded by later official confirmation (Dxx-OLD), syndicated duplicates (Dxx-DUP) and blog noise (Dxx-NOISE) never enter source_ids.
Units 11-20 carry the most complete uncertainty notes, naming the rumor, the superseded denial, and the excluded duplicate and noise explicitly.

Units 31-40 use a degraded three-word uncertainty style that still asserts correctly low uncertainty (official confirmation plus official corroboration exists) but does not articulate the conflict resolution path.
No unit claims any action taken; follow-up is conditioned on the stated TRIGGER-xx, keeping the outcome locally closing and fictional as required.

worst_unit.defect: Uncertainty note is a terse fragment ('low; corroborated by official update D31-LATE') that omits how the superseded archive denial D31-OLD and uncorroborated rumor D31-RUMOR were resolved, unlike the fuller notes on Units 11-20.
